name: Castles of Augustusburg and Falkenlust at Brühl
description: In Brühl, between Cologne and Bonn, Augustusburg Castle was built in the early 1700s as the lavish home of the prince-archbishops of Cologne. It ranks among Germany's first Rococo buildings. A garden walk leads to Falkenlust, a small hunting lodge made for falcon outings. Today the grounds also host the Brühl Palace Concerts, so you can hear music in the setting where it once played.
